This breakthrough combines the long-distance advantages of light with the interactive properties needed for future computing.
en.full_summary:
In modern electronics and spintronics, using the spin of particles to carry information is a promising idea, but these spin signals usually fizzle out over very short distances. On the other hand, photons can travel far, but they don't have the nonlinear interactions required to build logic gates for computing. 

To bridge this gap, researchers turned to polaritons—hybrid particles made of light and matter. By building special waveguides out of transition metal dichalcogenides, they achieved **spin propagation** of up to 100 micrometers while operating entirely at room temperature. More importantly, the system retains large polariton nonlinearities, meaning it opens the door to practical, ultra-fast **optical computing** and advanced information processing devices that don't need extreme cooling.

zh.title: 新技术让自旋信号在室温下传得更远
zh.summary: 科学家们用过渡金属硫化物做出了一种**激子极化激元波导**，能让自旋信号在室温下传出长达100微米的距离。这项突破把光能传得远的优点和做逻辑运算所需的**相互作用**结合在了一起。
zh.full_summary:
在自旋电子学里，利用粒子的自旋来传递信息是个好主意，但这些信号往往只能传很短的一段距离就消失了。另一方面，光子虽然能跑得很远，却缺乏做逻辑门计算所必需的非线性相互作用。

为了解决这个难题，研究人员把目光投向了光与物质结合的混合产物——极化激元。通过用过渡金属硫化物搭建特殊的波导结构，他们在**室温环境**下实现了长达100微米的自旋信号传输。更厉害的是，这个系统还保留了很强的非线性特性，为未来不需要极端低温的**光学计算**和高速信息处理设备铺平了道路。

en.title: Google and Adobe team up to put creative tools into Gmail and Docs
en.summary: Google and Adobe are expanding their partnership to **reduce app switching** by integrating Adobe's PDF and creative tools directly into everyday Google apps like Gmail, Google Drive, and Gemini. At the same time, Google's advanced AI models will power Adobe's software, helping people **work faster** and stay focused without constantly jumping between different programs.
en.full_summary:
## Deeper Integration
Google and Adobe are teaming up to solve a common annoyance: constantly jumping between different apps just to edit a file or tweak an image. Soon, tools like Adobe Acrobat will show up directly inside Gmail and Google Drive as quick options, letting you view and edit PDFs on the spot. 

## AI Collaboration
This partnership goes both ways. Adobe is bringing its connectors into Google's Gemini and Search, and integrating its CX Enterprise Coworker agent to help teams design graphics and launch marketing campaigns right inside enterprise workspaces. Meanwhile, Adobe is teaming up with Google DeepMind to **explore new features**, starting with an image model for Photoshop aimed at making near-real-time edits possible.

zh.title: 谷歌和Adobe强强联手：把修图和改PDF搬进你的常用软件
zh.summary: 谷歌和Adobe宣布扩大合作，把Adobe的图片和PDF处理工具直接塞进Gmail、谷歌网盘和Gemini等日常软件里。这意味着大家以后**不用频繁切换软件**就能直接改文件或处理图片，同时谷歌的先进AI模型也将为Adobe的各类应用**提供强力支持**，让日常办公和创作变得更顺手。
zh.full_summary:
## 告别频繁切屏
谷歌和Adobe这次合作的目标很直接，就是为了解决大家在不同软件之间跳来跳去处理文件的烦恼。很快，用户在Gmail和谷歌网盘里就能直接看到Adobe Acrobat的快捷入口，预览文件时点一下就能开始编辑。

## 深度融合AI
除了办公软件的打通，双方还把AI技术揉合到了一起。Adobe的工具将接入谷歌的Gemini和搜索功能，企业用户甚至可以直接在Gemini里使用Adobe的AI助手来设计海报和做营销。此外，Adobe还将携手谷歌DeepMind，**探索全新功能**，计划为Photoshop开发能实现准实时编辑的图像模型。

en.title: Zhengyuan Quantum Secures Funding to Tackle Thousand-Qubit Superconducting Challenges
en.summary: Superconducting quantum computing is tackling the **scaling bottleneck**, aiming to build a thousand-qubit machine. Recently, startup Zhengyuan Quantum secured nearly **100 million yuan** in angel funding to develop crucial technologies like 3D packaging and signal routing. This step is vital because as quantum chips grow larger, standard wiring struggles to keep up, making system-level engineering essential for practical applications.
en.full_summary:
## Background and Challenges
Building quantum computers requires keeping fragile quantum states stable near absolute zero while precisely controlling them. As researchers successfully demonstrate quantum error correction where error rates drop with scale, a new bottleneck emerges: the physical limits of wiring and packaging. More qubits mean more control signals, but chip edges cannot expand indefinitely.

## Technical Solutions
Zhengyuan Quantum is tackling this by moving connections into the third dimension, using Through-Silicon Vias (TSV) and 3D integration packaging to route signals vertically. This approach helps ease the wiring congestion at the chip's perimeter. The new funding will accelerate these hardware integration steps, along with developing cryogenic harnesses and quantum EDA design tools.

## Future Impact
Ultimately, these engineering efforts aim to deliver reliable thousand-qubit systems that can handle complex simulations in chemistry and materials science, helping researchers model molecules and design new drugs or catalysts before expensive physical experiments.

zh.title: 正元量子获近亿元融资，发力千比特超导量子计算机
zh.summary: 超导量子计算正迎来**规模化大考**，目标直指千比特整机。近期，初创公司正元量子宣布完成近亿元天使轮融资，重点攻克三维封装和线路连接等难题。随着芯片上的量子比特越来越多，传统的外部连线越来越拥挤，必须从整机系统设计入手，才能让更多比特**稳定可靠**地一起工作。
zh.full_summary:
## 背景与挑战
造量子计算机就像是在极低温的极端环境下做精密手术。随着量子纠错实验取得进展，科学家发现“越纠越对”的前提是必须容纳更多高质量比特。然而，随之而来的麻烦是**接线边界跟不上**。芯片面积扩大了，边缘引出的信号线却非常拥挤，外部线路还要穿过不同温区，稍有不慎就会带来热量和干扰。

## 技术突破
正元量子选择从芯片的底层连接切入，尝试把平面连接转向第三维度。通过硅通孔技术和三维集成封装，他们让部分信号从垂直方向引出，从而缓解边缘出线的限制。本轮融资将直接用于推进**三维集成封装**和高密度线束研发，配合量子EDA设计工具，为千比特整机打下工程基础。

## 行业影响
千比特整机不仅是硬件规模的升级，更是对芯片、封装与测控系统的一次综合大考。当这些底层技术成熟后，超导量子计算机将更有希望接入化学模拟和新药研发等实际场景，在昂贵的物理实验开始之前，为科学家提供**更准确的预测依据**。

en.title: Anthropic plans to move forward with IPO
en.summary: Despite market turbulence, AI startup **Anthropic** is pushing ahead with its IPO plans, aiming to start trading as early as next week. Investors will use its **valuation** to judge the health of the entire artificial intelligence market, as early target figures face downward pressure.
en.full_summary: According to reports, Anthropic is preparing to set its valuation range and could begin trading as soon as next week. This move comes at a challenging time for tech listings following recent market selloffs. Institutional investors are reportedly pushing for a valuation lower than previous ambitious targets, reflecting a more cautious sentiment in the sector. Meanwhile, its main competitor OpenAI recently secured fresh capital at a valuation that also fell short of its initial high expectations, highlighting a cooling trend in investor enthusiasm for massive AI valuations.

zh.title: 人工智能初创公司Anthropic计划推进上市
zh.summary: 尽管市场近期出现震荡，人工智能初创公司 **Anthropic** 依然决定推进上市计划，预计最快下周正式挂牌交易。华尔街将通过这次上市的 **估值情况** 来判断整股人工智能热潮的真实热度，目前其估值目标正面临投资者的下调压力。
zh.full_summary: 根据媒体报道，Anthropic计划在本周确定估值区间，并最快于下周四或周五开始公开交易。在经历了一系列科技股抛售和市场动荡之后，这一上市举动备受瞩目。机构投资者目前正在推动将估值压低至此前讨论的目标以下，反映出市场情绪趋于谨慎。与此同时，其主要竞争对手OpenAI近期在新一轮融资中的估值也低于最初的预期，这表明资本对超高估值的追捧正在降温。

en.title: How skills and agents work in AWS Quick
en.summary: AWS Quick is an AI service that automates tasks and analyzes data using agents and **reusable skills**. It relies on natural language and connected data to streamline team workflows, letting users build and **share custom skills** easily.
en.full_summary:
## Core Concepts
AWS Quick places an AI agent at the center, which follows instructions, loads required skills, and interacts with connected data sources like knowledge bases and dashboards. By default, every user has access to Quick, but teams can also configure **custom agents** for specific tasks such as HR onboarding.

## Working with Skills
A skill in AWS Quick is a reusable set of instructions based on an open standard, acting like a folder with a Markdown file and optional scripts. Quick uses system skills for common tasks like generating documents or browsing the web, while allowing users to create, **publish and share** their own custom skills.

## Best Practices
Building production-ready skills requires engineering best practices. Creators must plan for potential failures, test every change, and avoid hardcoded values to ensure skills work seamlessly across different environments and team members.

zh.title: AWS Quick 如何通过技能与智能体帮你自动化日常工作
zh.summary: AWS Quick 是一项利用人工智能自动处理任务的云服务，它通过智能体和**可复用技能**来帮你搞定各种重复工作。你可以用大白话和它交流，把日常琐事变成自动化流程，还能跟团队成员**分享专属技能**。
zh.full_summary:
## 核心概念
AWS Quick 的核心是一个智能体，它能听从指令、加载所需的技能，并结合你连接的各种数据源（如知识库和仪表盘）来回答问题。除了默认人人都能用的通用智能体外，你还可以为特定岗位（比如人事入职）配置专属的**定制智能体**。

## 技能的工作原理
在 AWS Quick 中，技能是一套教智能体如何完成特定任务的可复用指令。系统自带了许多基础技能，比如帮你写文档或浏览网页，而用户也可以自己动手制作、**发布并共享**个性化技能给团队伙伴。

## 最佳实践
要想制作出能在团队里稳定运行的技能，你需要借鉴一些软件开发的经验。比如提前考虑各种报错情况、对每次修改进行测试，并且不要把个人电脑的本地路径写死，从而确保技能在不同人的电脑上都能**顺利运行**。

en.title: AMD, Supermicro, and Spectro Cloud Launch On-Premises AI Coding Platform
en.summary: AMD, Supermicro, and Spectro Cloud have teamed up to release the **Instinct Coder 355**, an on-premises AI coding platform for enterprises. It combines AMD hardware with local models like GLM-5.3 to handle routine coding tasks locally, helping companies **reduce costs** while protecting sensitive source code from leaving their internal servers.
en.full_summary:
## Platform Background
As companies increasingly adopt AI for software development, relying entirely on external frontier models can lead to unpredictable token costs and data privacy concerns. To solve this, the AMD Instinct Coder 355 offers a turnkey, on-premises solution that balances local processing with access to powerful external models when needed.

## Hardware and Software
The system runs on Supermicro servers powered by AMD EPYC processors, AMD Instinct MI355X GPUs, and Pensando Networking. On the software side, it features Spectro Cloud's PaletteAI Inference Launchpad and uses the GLM-5.3 model for local tasks, while remaining compatible with external services like Claude or GPT when approved.

## Cost and Security
By running routine tasks locally by default, enterprises can **slash expenses** compared to using metered cloud APIs for everything. Furthermore, keeping code processing within internal infrastructure ensures that proprietary data remains secure under strict **corporate governance** policies.

zh.title: AMD联合超微与Spectro Cloud推出企业级本地AI编程平台
zh.summary: AMD携手超微与Spectro Cloud推出了企业级本地AI编程平台**Instinct Coder 355**。该平台结合了AMD的硬件与GLM-5.3等本地模型，能够把日常编程任务留在本地处理，在**降低成本**的同时，防止敏感的源代码泄露到外部服务器。
zh.full_summary:
## 平台背景
随着AI在软件开发中的普及，完全依赖外部大模型会导致无法预测的使用成本以及数据隐私隐患。为了解决这些痛点，AMD Instinct Coder 355提供了一套开箱即用的本地化解决方案，在处理日常任务时优先使用本地资源，同时在必要时按需调用外部大模型。

## 软硬件配置
该系统搭载了超微服务器，内部采用AMD EPYC处理器、MI355X显卡以及Pensando网络设备。软件方面则整合了Spectro Cloud的管理平台，并以GLM-5.3作为本地主力模型，同时也支持在策略允许时连接Claude或GPT等外部服务。

## 成本与安全
通过将常规开发任务默认放在本地运行，企业可以大幅**削减开支**，告别按量付费的云端API无底洞。同时，将代码留在内部服务器处理，能确保敏感的商业机密符合严格的**数据安全**合规要求。

en.title: Macron calls for bans on AI that threatens children
en.summary: French President Emmanuel Macron has called for **banning AI** wherever it harms children's mental health. Ahead of a new charter being adopted at the Paris Peace Forum, Macron is pushing for **strict pre-audits** and regulations on tech giants like OpenAI and Anthropic to protect young minds.
en.full_summary:
French President Emmanuel Macron has proposed a ban on artificial intelligence in areas where it risks children's mental health and brain development, comparing the current tech landscape to the 'Wild West.' In an interview with Les Echos, Macron emphasized that AI applications should not be allowed to bypass child protection standards. 

To address these risks, a committee of experts is set to present recommendations on safeguarding children from AI. Concurrently, a new charter will be introduced at the Paris Peace Forum, involving major industry players such as OpenAI, Anthropic, Microsoft, and Mistral. This initiative aims to establish principles of **pre-audit and pre-certification** for AI models before they reach younger users, serving as a stepping stone for future national and European legislation.

zh.title: 马克龙呼吁全面禁止威胁儿童的AI应用
zh.summary: 法国总统马克龙公开表示，任何对**儿童心理健康**造成威胁的AI应用都应该被禁止。在巴黎和平论坛采纳相关宪章前，马克龙正力推对科技巨头进行**严格的预先审核**，为未成年人筑起安全防线。
zh.full_summary:
法国总统马克龙近日公开呼吁，任何对儿童心理健康和大脑发育构成风险的AI应用都应当被禁止，并直言不能让AI领域变成无法无天的“蛮荒西部”。他在接受媒体采访时强调，科技产品绝不能以牺牲青少年的身心健康为代价。

为了应对这一挑战，一个专家委员会向其提交了关于AI儿童保护的建议报告。与此同时，在巴黎和平论坛上推出了一项全新宪章，吸引了包括OpenAI、Anthropic、微软和Mistral在内的全球科技巨头参与。该宪章的核心内容是引入**预先审核与认证**机制，在AI模型面向儿童开放前进行严格审查，旨在为未来的法国国内及欧洲立法奠定基础。

en.title: FDA approves Bayer's new stroke drug Sunharbo
en.summary: The FDA has approved Bayer's **new drug**, Sunharbo, to help prevent recurrent strokes. As the first in a novel class of medications, it targets a specific protein to block dangerous blood clots **without increasing** the usual risk of bleeding.
en.full_summary:
## Background
Traditional blood thinners are often avoided after a stroke because they carry a high risk of dangerous bleeding. Researchers have long searched for a way to prevent secondary strokes more safely without this major downside.

## Details
Bayer's newly approved drug, Sunharbo, works by inhibiting a specific protein called XIa. In a large Phase 3 clinical trial involving patients who had previously suffered a stroke, the drug successfully **reduced the risk** of secondary strokes by 26% compared to a placebo. 

## Impact
This approval introduces an entirely **new class** of medications to cardiovascular medicine, offering doctors a safer tool to protect stroke survivors and potentially changing how long-term stroke prevention is managed.

zh.title: 美国食药监局批准拜耳新型抗中风药物Sunharbo
zh.summary: 美国食药监局近日批准了拜耳公司的一款**全新药物**Sunharbo，用来降低中风复发的风险。作为同类药物中的首创，它通过靶向特定蛋白来阻止危险血栓的形成，同时**不会增加**出血风险。
zh.full_summary:
## 背景
传统的血液稀释剂在预防中风复发时往往受到限制，因为它们会显著增加患者大出血的风险。医学界一直希望找到一种更安全、不会带来严重出血副作用的方法来预防二次中风。

## 细节
拜耳公司获批的新药Sunharbo通过抑制一种名为XIa的蛋白来发挥作用。在一项针对已中风患者的3期临床试验中，与安慰剂相比，该药成功将二次中风的**风险降低**了26%。

## 影响
这款药物的获批标志着心血管医疗领域迎来了一种**全新类别**的药物，为医生提供了更安全的治疗工具，有望改变未来中风长期预防的临床实践。

en.title: Qantas to cut 850 Australian jobs and outsource work to India under AI-driven overhaul
en.summary: Qantas is planning to **cut 850 jobs** in Australia and **outsource work to India** as part of a major technology and AI-driven overhaul. The airline is teaming up with Accenture to modernize its internal systems, affecting workers in finance, human resources, and marketing. Unions have strongly criticized the move, arguing that everyday employees shouldn't have to pay the price for **rapid technological change**.
en.full_summary:
## Background
Qantas has announced a multi-year partnership with Accenture to upgrade its background systems, data, and processes, heavily relying on **new technology and AI**. This makes it the third major Australian company to announce massive corporate layoffs within three weeks, following similar restructuring moves by Canva and National Australia Bank.

## Details
The initial wave of cuts will eliminate **850 local jobs**, primarily targeting finance, procurement, human resources, and marketing departments. Some of these operational tasks will be shifted to Accenture's large workforce based in India. Qantas chief executive Vanessa Hudson stated that the airline will consult with unions and affected employees, with the first transition expected by the middle of next year.

## Impact
This decision has sparked immediate pushback from labor unions, who pointed out that Qantas previously promised not to offshore more jobs. The cuts land during a tough economic climate for Australians, characterized by a nearly five-year high in the unemployment rate and soaring living costs. Across Qantas, Canva, and National Australia Bank, **4,550 corporate roles** have faced cuts or restructuring over the past month alone.

zh.title: 澳洲航空将裁员850人并将部分工作外包至印度，以推进AI转型
zh.summary: 澳洲航空计划在其**技术和AI升级**大动作中，在澳大利亚**裁员850人**并将部分工作**外包到印度**。这家航空公司正与埃森哲合作升级其内部系统，受影响的主要是财务、人力资源和市场营销岗位的员工。工会对此强烈批评，认为普通员工不应该为**快速的技术变革**买单。
zh.full_summary:
## 背景
澳洲航空宣布与埃森哲达成一项多年的合作协议，通过大力投入**新技术和AI**来全面升级其后台系统、数据和流程。这也是继Canva和澳大利亚国民银行之后，短短三周内在澳大利亚宣布的第三个重大企业裁员计划。

## 细节
首批裁员将削减**850个本地岗位**，主要集中在财务、采购、人力资源和市场营销部门。其中部分业务将被转移至埃森哲位于印度的庞大团队。澳航首席执行官瓦妮莎·哈德逊表示，公司将在最终决定做出前与工会和受影响员工进行协商，首批调整预计将在明年年中落地。

## 影响
此举引发了工会的强烈抗议，工会指出澳航此前曾承诺不会将更多工作岗位转移到海外。当前正值澳大利亚经济艰难时期，失业率逼近近五年来的最高点，生活成本居高不下。仅在过去一个月里，澳航、Canva和澳大利亚国民银行这三家公司就已经累计将**4,550个企业岗位**列入裁员、调岗或重组的目标。

en.title: New statistical method matches cellular states to known biological perturbations
en.summary: Researchers have developed a statistical framework called **RNA fingerprinting** to match single-cell RNA sequencing data with reference perturbation dictionaries. Published in Cell, the method uses a **Bayesian probabilistic framework** to accurately identify cellular responses across different cell types and datasets, helping scientists better understand complex biological mechanisms.
en.full_summary:
Single-cell perturbation dictionaries are vital tools for interpreting large-scale transcriptomic data by cataloguing how cells respond to various biological and chemical stimuli. However, matching new experimental cellular states to these reference dictionaries has historically been difficult due to technical noise and biological variability.

To solve this, Grabski and colleagues introduced RNA fingerprinting, a two-stage statistical approach. First, it extracts **denoised perturbation signatures** from a reference dictionary. Next, it applies a Bayesian probabilistic framework—adapted from genome-wide association studies—to compare query cells against these fingerprints.

According to ground-truth dataset evaluations, the method reliably identifies known perturbations **across cell types** and scales effectively to genome-wide datasets and combinatorial perturbations. This framework offers a robust solution for researchers analyzing complex single-cell transcriptomic responses.

zh.title: 新技术通过RNA指纹精准匹配细胞状态与已知生物刺激
zh.summary: 科学家们开发了一种名为**RNA指纹**的统计方法，能够将单细胞测序数据与已知的生物刺激字典进行精准匹配。这项发表在《细胞》杂志上的研究利用了**贝叶斯概率框架**，成功在不同细胞类型中准确识别细胞反应，帮助科研人员更好地理解复杂的生物学机制。
zh.full_summary:
单细胞扰动字典是解读大规模转录组数据的重要工具，通过记录细胞对各种生物和化学刺激的反应来帮助分析机制。然而，由于技术噪音和生物变异，将新的实验细胞状态与这些参考字典进行匹配一直是个难题。

为了解决这个问题，研究人员开发了一种名为RNA指纹的两阶段统计方法。首先，它从参考字典中提取出**去噪后的扰动特征**。接着，它借鉴全基因组关联分析的方法，利用贝叶斯概率框架将待测细胞与这些指纹进行比对。

在真实数据集上的测试表明，该方法能够跨细胞类型**精准匹配已知扰动**，并且能够扩展到全基因组数据集和组合扰动分析中。这项技术为解析复杂的单细胞转录组反应提供了一个强大的新工具。

en.title: Google brings Gemini Intelligence to more devices with new features
en.summary: Google is expanding **Gemini Intelligence** to more Android devices like the Pixel 10 and Motorola Signature 27, while rolling out **cool new features** like custom widget creation and built-in tech support to make your phone smarter and easier to use.
en.full_summary:
Google is aggressively expanding its Gemini Intelligence ecosystem to a broader range of hardware, including the newly supported Pixel 10 series and Motorola Signature 27, while bringing features like Rambler and task automation to more regions.

Key new additions include Create My Widget, which allows users to design personalized home screen widgets using just a text prompt without any coding, and Device Assistance, turning Gemini into a built-in expert that can manage phone settings, clear storage, and handle privacy checks through natural conversation.

Additionally, Gemini is breaking into new form factors and scenarios, integrating proactive suggestions into Android Auto to connect messages with emails on the go, and bringing custom widgets to the Pixel Watch.

zh.title: 谷歌将双子星智能带入更多设备并推出全新功能
zh.summary: 谷歌正在将**双子星智能**扩展到Pixel 10和摩托罗拉等更多安卓设备上，并推出了通过简单描述**定制小组件**以及帮你搞定手机设置的全新功能，让日常使用变得更轻松。
zh.full_summary:
谷歌正在加速将双子星智能推向更多硬件设备，除了支持最新的Pixel 10系列和摩托罗拉新机外，还把实时语音转文字和跨应用任务自动化等实用功能带到了更多地区。

此次更新的亮点包括“创建我的小组件”功能，用户只需用大白话描述需求就能**自动生成桌面小组件**，完全不需要懂编程。同时推出的设备助手功能，能让手机变成你的专属客服，通过日常对话帮你**清理内存或检查权限**。

此外，这项智能技术还在向更多场景渗透，比如在车载安卓系统上提供**主动智能建议**，并把自定义小组件功能带到智能手表上，让多设备协同变得更加顺手。

en.title: Australia's PM faces a political storm over AI copyright and the creative sector
en.summary: Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese is facing a tough political dilemma as he weighs whether to attract massive AI datacentres or protect local artists. Tech companies want Australia to relax **copyright laws** to build their data hubs, but creators are furious that AI models have been trained on **stolen property**. This clash puts the government's long-standing alliance with the **creative sector** at serious risk.
en.full_summary:
The Australian government is being courted by AI hyperscalers like Anthropic, which wants to base training models and renewable datacentres in the country, potentially creating a lucrative new green industry. However, this economic vision comes with a catch: tech companies are pushing the government to relax **copyright laws** that currently protect artistic work from being scraped without consent. Critics argue this would turn Australia into a global haven for data-washing.

Beyond intellectual property, the rise of AI is triggering broader societal concerns, ranging from the automated mimicry of human art to the erosion of educational cognitive skills and mounting pressures on energy and water resources. The **creative sector**, traditionally a loyal political ally of the Labor party, is fiercely pushing back against what they see as a sell-out, demanding proper control, compensation, and the active promotion of human work.

zh.title: 澳大利亚总理面临关于人工智能版权与创意产业的政治风暴
zh.summary: 澳大利亚总理安东尼·阿尔巴尼斯正面临一个艰难的政治抉择：是吸引大规模的AI数据中心，还是保护本土艺术家的利益。科技巨头希望澳大利亚放宽**版权法**来建设数据枢纽，但创作者们对AI模型使用**被盗财产**进行训练感到愤怒。这场冲突将政府与**创意产业**长期以来的联盟推向了危险境地。
zh.full_summary:
澳大利亚政府正受到Anthropic等AI巨头的游说，这些公司希望在该国建立训练模型和可再生数据中心，从而打造利润丰厚的绿色新产业。然而，这一经济愿景伴随着代价：科技公司正敦促政府放宽**版权法**，而现行法律本可保护艺术作品不经同意就被抓取。批评人士认为，此举将把澳大利亚变成全球数据洗钱的天堂。

除了知识产权，人工智能的崛起还引发了更广泛的社会担忧，从对人类艺术的自动化模仿，到教育认知能力的退化，以及对能源和水资源日益增长的压力。**创意产业**作为工党传统的政治盟友，正激烈反对他们所认为的“出卖”行为，并要求获得适当的控制权、赔偿以及对人类作品的大力推广。

en.title: Hollywood is fighting back against AI as storyboard artists face displacement
en.summary: AI is already affecting behind-the-scenes jobs in Hollywood, with **storyboard artists** bearing the brunt of the impact as major film-makers adopt text-to-image tech. While big directors like Martin Scorsese and James Cameron dabble with AI tools, artists argue that storyboarding is not just about drawing pictures, but a **collaborative creative process** that builds human connection and cinematic language. Many believe the rise of AI will ultimately lead to a greater **appreciation for human authenticity** in filmmaking.
en.full_summary:
## The Threat to Storyboards
While the prospect of fully AI-generated movies is still on the horizon, generative AI tools are already stepping on the toes of Hollywood's storyboard artists. Traditionally, these illustrators work hand-in-hand with directors, cinematographers, and crew members to map out scenes, serving as the blueprint for the entire production. Now, text-to-image software threatens to replace this foundational step, with directors like Martin Scorsese even partnering with AI firms for their upcoming projects.

## The Human Collaborative Process
Artists emphasize that storyboarding is much more than just producing pretty pictures; it is a vital part of **human collaboration**. British storyboard artist Alex Clark points out that hashing out ideas, acting things out, and discussing details with the crew creates a shared creative vision. Legendary directors like Denis Villeneuve and Bong Joon-ho view storyboarding as an extension of the director's brain and a crucial form of cinematic writing that fosters spontaneity and emotional connection.

## Future Outlook
Despite the creeping influence of AI, experts and artists believe that the core of filmmaking relies on human touch. Some academics suggest that the friction and difficulty of traditional artistic collaboration are actually the whole point of making art. As AI tools become more common, industry insiders predict that audiences and creators will place an even higher value on **human authenticity** and the unique imperfections of hand-crafted cinema.

zh.title: 好莱坞的分镜画师正在被AI冲击，电影行业展开反击
zh.summary: AI已经开始影响好莱坞的幕后工作，随着大导演们纷纷试水新技术，**分镜画师**成了首当其冲受冲击的群体。虽然马丁·斯科塞斯和詹姆斯·卡梅隆等大咖都在尝试使用AI工具，但从业者认为分镜不仅是画画，更是一个需要真人沟通的**合作创作过程**。许多人相信，AI的泛滥最终反而会让人类更加珍惜电影里的**人情味**。
zh.full_summary:
## 分镜画师面临的危机
虽然全AI生成的电影还在未来，但生成式AI工具已经开始抢好莱坞分镜画师的饭碗了。按照传统，画师们需要和导演、摄影师及剧组密切合作，把剧本变成一幅幅指引拍摄的分镜头草图。如今，文生图软件正威胁要取代这一步，甚至连马丁·斯科塞斯这样的大导演也开始在新电影中尝试使用AI工具来做分镜。

## 珍贵的真人协作
从业者强调，分镜远不止是画出漂亮的图片，它更是不可或缺的**人类协作过程**。英国分镜画师亚历克斯·克拉克指出，大家坐在一起讨论、甚至现场演练细节的过程，能创造出独特的集体创作火花。像丹尼斯·维伦纽瓦和奉俊昊这样的名导，一直把分镜视为导演大脑的延伸和电影语言的第一步，其中充满了意外的惊喜和情感连接。

## 行业的未来展望
尽管AI步步紧逼，艺术家和学者们依然坚信电影的核心在于人类的情感。有学者指出，传统艺术创作中那些磕磕绊绊的沟通，恰恰是艺术本身的价值所在。业内人士预测，随着AI越来越普及，大家反而会更加珍惜带有**人类真实温度**的手工电影质感。

en.title: How Workday Built Its Enterprise AI Agent Platform with LangGraph
en.summary: Workday built a production-ready AI agent platform using **LangGraph and LangSmith**, reducing prototype time from months to less than a day while meeting **strict enterprise security** and governance requirements.
en.full_summary:
Facing the demand to build and deploy production-ready AI agents by 2026, a small initial team of four at Workday set out to create an internal developer platform. Operating under strict enterprise security and data governance policies, they needed a solution that supported rapid prototyping and robust compliance. By leveraging LangGraph for agent orchestration and LangSmith for evaluation and observability, the team abstracted away underlying infrastructure.

They developed a Python SDK dubbed 'Workday LangChain' to wrap primitives and connect with internal systems like LLM gateways and RAG services. This setup allowed them to out-of-the-box support advanced protocols like A2A and MCP. As a result, prototype delivery dropped from five months to under a day, enabling the team to scale up significantly and unify Workday's fragmented internal services into a single cohesive agent interface.

zh.title: Workday如何利用LangGraph打造企业级AI代理平台
zh.summary: 企业服务巨头Workday利用**LangGraph和LangSmith**快速搭建了内部AI代理平台，将原型开发时间从数月缩短至**不到一天**，同时满足了严格的安全与合规要求。
zh.full_summary:
面对在2025年启动、计划于2026年底前将AI代理投入生产的大胆目标，Workday仅由4人组成的团队着手打造内部开发平台。在极为严格的企业安全与合规框架下，他们需要平衡快速原型开发与后端审计。通过引入LangGraph负责代理编排、LangSmith负责监控与评估，团队成功抽象化了底层基础设施。

他们开发了内部Python SDK，将LangChain原语与Workday的LLM网关、RAG检索等内部服务打通，从而原生支持了A2A和MCP等前沿协议。这一平台将原本需要4到5个月的原型开发周期缩短至**不到一天**，不仅促使团队规模扩大了数倍，还将Workday过去孤立的内部服务串联成统一的代理接口。

en.title: How AI and Robotics Help Recyclers Turn Mixed Waste Into Reusable Materials
en.summary: Global waste is piling up, but only a tiny fraction gets recycled due to manual labor shortages and messy materials. Startups are now using **computer vision and AI** to sort plastics, textiles, and household trash with incredible speed and accuracy. This breakthrough helps factories **cut operating costs** while keeping valuable resources in circulation.
en.full_summary:
## The Recycling Challenge
Globally, less than 7% of materials come from recycled sources, and municipal solid waste could nearly double by 2050. Traditional recycling relies heavily on hard-to-find manual labor, making it difficult to sort mixed scrap accurately and cost-effectively.

## AI-Powered Solutions
Innovative startups are deploying edge AI and robotics to revolutionize recycling plants. Taiwan-based AIRECO uses vision AI to sort plastics for closed-loop recycling, aiming to triple processing capacity. EverestLabs AI operates robots on fast-moving conveyor belts across North America and Australia, identifying billions of objects. U.K.-based Greyparrot monitors waste streams in real time, replacing outdated manual sampling with instant analytics. Meanwhile, Germany's reverse.fashion automates the tedious task of sorting used textiles by analyzing fabric quality and defects at high speeds.

## Industry Impact
By leveraging advanced computing, these companies are drastically **improving sorting efficiency** and boosting the yield of reusable materials. Major brands and recycling facilities are using these tools to reduce carbon emissions and build a more sustainable circular economy.

zh.title: AI和机器人如何帮回收厂把混杂垃圾变成宝
zh.summary: 全球垃圾堆积如山，但由于人工短缺和分拣困难，回收率一直很低。现在，多家初创企业正利用**计算机视觉与AI**技术，以极高的速度和准确率对塑料、纺织品和生活垃圾进行精细化分拣。这一技术突破不仅帮工厂**大幅削减成本**，还让宝贵的废旧资源重新回到循环利用的链条中。
zh.full_summary:
## 垃圾回收的困境
全球只有不到7%的材料来自回收资源，而城市生活垃圾预计到2050年将翻一番。传统的回收严重依赖人工，不仅费时费力，还很难把混杂的废弃物准确分类，导致许多材料只能被降级处理。

## AI带来的改变
全球多地的初创企业正在将AI与机器人技术引入垃圾分拣线。中国台湾的AIRECO利用视觉AI实现塑料的高精度分类，计划将处理能力提升近三倍。美国的EverestLabs AI在高速传送带上部署分拣机器人，目前已处理了数十亿个物件。英国的Greyparrot则通过实时监控废物流，彻底改变了过去靠人工抽样检查的落后做法。此外，德国的reverse.fashion利用高分辨率AI快速识别旧衣服的材质和瑕疵，把原本需要一周的人工分拣缩短到一个小时。

## 实际应用效果
通过边缘计算和深度学习，这些AI系统正在**大幅提升回收效率**，让更多塑料和纺织品能够真正循环使用。这不仅降低了企业的运营成本，也为全球的可持续发展注入了强劲动力。

en.title: Ring is finally launching its flying indoor security drone
en.summary: Ring is releasing its **AI-powered drone camera** for indoor security, priced at $249.99 and set to ship in January 2027. It patrols your home automatically when triggered by sensors, offering 2K resolution and cloud-based navigation while addressing privacy concerns by recording only during flight.
en.full_summary:
## How It Works
The new Ring Drone Cam is an autonomous indoor drone designed to replace multiple stationary security cameras. Powered by a new AI system called AI Pilot, it flies along preprogrammed routes when triggered by home sensors like motion detectors or door openings. It features a 2K camera with a 148-degree field of view and weighs just 165 grams.

## Development and Privacy
Ring has spent years developing the device, finally redesigning it to rely on cloud processing to keep the price down. To address **privacy concerns**, the drone only records while flying, remains shuttered in its dock, and uses a rotating encryption system for its footage. However, it relies heavily on an internet connection and only offers a short flight time of five to eight minutes per charge.

zh.title: 亚马逊旗下Ring终于要推出室内巡逻无人机了
zh.summary: 亚马逊旗下的Ring即将在2027年1月推出售价249.99美元的**室内巡逻无人机**。它能在家里自动飞来飞去帮你巡逻，当感应器被触发时就会出动，画质达到2K，并且只有在飞行时才会进行录像，试图打消大家的隐私顾虑。
zh.full_summary:
## 工作原理
这款全新的Ring室内无人机旨在替代家里装的好几个固定摄像头。它搭载了名为AI Pilot的**人工智能系统**，当家里的门窗传感器或移动侦测器被触发时，它就会沿着预设路线自动起飞巡逻。它拥有2K分辨率和148度的广角视野，机身重量只有165克。

## 开发历程与隐私
Ring为此研发多年，最终选择将核心技术放在云端以控制成本。为了缓解用户的**隐私担忧**，这款无人机只有在飞行时才会录像，平时在底座上时镜头是关着的，视频也采用了加密技术。不过，它非常依赖网络信号，且每次充电只能飞5到8分钟。

en.title: France calls for strict rules on AI assistants to protect minors
en.summary: A new report submitted to French President Emmanuel Macron urges **immediate regulation** of mainstream AI assistants like ChatGPT and Gemini. The advisory council warns that highly personalized chat tools create serious **risks of dependence** and psychological exploitation, especially for minors, by monetizing human cognitive abilities and emotional responses.
en.full_summary:
## Background and Mission
Following a mandate given at the New Delhi AI summit, the French Council on AI and Digital Technology investigated how popular AI services exploit user vulnerabilities. While stopping short of an outright ban for minors, the report highlights the emergence of a **cognition economy** where platforms profit from psychological profiles and emotional manipulation.

## Key Proposals
The council recommends banning default features that make AIs feel human, such as flattery and anthropomorphization. It also demands **stricter safety guardrails**, including better detection of self-harm topics, mandatory reminders that users are talking to machines, and accessible reporting mechanisms for problematic AI replies.

zh.title: 法国呼吁对人工智能助手进行严格监管以保护未成年人
zh.summary: 一份提交给法国总统马克龙的新报告敦促对像ChatGPT和双子座这样的主流AI助手进行**立即监管**。咨询委员会警告说，高度个性的聊天工具会带来严重的**依赖风险**和心理剥削，特别是对未成年人而言，因为它们正试图通过将人类的认知能力和情感反应进行商业化变现。
zh.full_summary:
## 背景与任务
在响应新德里AI峰会的委任后，法国人工智能与数字技术委员会调查了热门AI服务如何利用用户弱点。尽管该报告没有提议对未成年人全面禁封AI，但它指出了**认知经济**的兴起，即平台通过用户的心理画像和情感操纵来获取利润。

## 核心建议
委员会建议禁用默认让AI显得像人类的功能，例如恭维和拟人化。它还要求设立**更严格的安全护栏**，包括更好地检测自残话题、强制提醒用户正在与机器对话，以及为有问题的AI回复建立便捷的举报机制。

en.title: Capricor pumps up spending and factory prep while waiting for FDA verdict on muscle disease drug
en.summary: Capricor Therapeutics saw its **operating expenses surge 70%** in the third quarter as it ramps up manufacturing for its upcoming Duchenne muscular dystrophy cell therapy. With an **FDA decision looming**, the company's San Diego facility is fully prepped for an initial launch, though past regulatory hurdles and a mixed advisory vote still cast some uncertainty over the approval.
en.full_summary:
Capricor Therapeutics has significantly accelerated its financial and operational preparations ahead of a crucial FDA decision regarding its cell therapy, deramiocel, scheduled for November 22. During the third quarter, the company's spending jumped to $44.7 million, marking a 70% increase compared to the same period last year, driven primarily by precommercial activities and the scale-up of manufacturing capabilities at its San Diego facility. 

During a recent earnings call, CEO Linda Marbán confirmed that the first-floor cleanroom is fully operational, having passed a pre-license inspection and equipped to supply doses for up to 250 patients annually. Furthermore, Capricor is already expanding into the second floor to eventually support 2,000 to 2,500 patients per year, with validation scheduled for the first half of next year. 

Despite these proactive measures, the path to commercialization remains bumpy. Capricor's previous filing faced rejection due to manufacturing deficiencies, and an advisory committee recently voted against the therapy, leaving its approval status uncertain. If the FDA rejects the current application, company leadership plans to carefully evaluate the feedback to determine if additional clinical trials are warranted.

zh.title: 等待FDA裁决之际，Capricor加大生产投入为新药上市做准备
zh.summary: 随着杜氏肌营养不良症细胞疗法即将迎来FDA裁决，Capricor Therapeutics在第三季度的**运营费用大幅飙升70%**。尽管此前曾遭遇监管阻力且顾问委员会投票遇挫，该公司位于圣迭戈的工厂目前已**做好了上市前的生产准备**，全力迎接即将到来的关键时刻。
zh.full_summary:
在迎来针对其细胞疗法deramiocel的关键FDA裁决前夕，Capricor Therapeutics大幅加快了资金投入与生产准备步伐。第三季度，该公司的支出飙升至4470万美元，比去年同期增长了70%，主要用于**扩大圣迭戈工厂的产能**以及开展各项上市前的筹备工作。

公司CEO琳达·马尔班在财报电话会议上表示，圣迭戈工厂的一层洁净室已经准备就绪，不仅通过了上市前的检查，还能每年为多达250名患者提供药物。与此同时，公司正在对二楼进行产能扩展，预计在完成验证后，年产能将提升至2000到2500名患者水平，以满足长期的市场需求。

不过，该疗法的商业化之路并非一帆风顺。由于此前曾因生产和化学控制问题遭到FDA拒绝，加上近期顾问委员会投出了反对票，外界对此次能否顺利获批仍存疑虑。如果此次未能获得FDA批准，管理层表示将审慎评估反馈，考虑是否需要通过进一步的临床试验来证明其有效性与安全性。

en.title: How to Use Gemini Notebook to Slash Internal Support Costs
en.summary: Gemini Notebook lets companies build custom AI helpers by simply uploading existing manuals and documents. It answers routine employee questions with citations and generates FAQs or handover materials instantly, **saving countless hours** for HR and administrative teams.
en.full_summary: Managing repetitive internal inquiries regarding expense claims, HR rules, and IT systems often drains administrative bandwidth. Gemini Notebook addresses this by allowing teams to ingest PDFs, documents, and web pages without requiring new content creation. When staff ask questions, the tool provides direct answers along with exact source citations, ensuring high transparency and preventing hallucinations when information is missing. Furthermore, the system can automate the creation of FAQ drafts and staff handover materials complete with presentation outlines. To ensure safe deployment, companies are advised to use Google Workspace for information governance, verify document accuracy before uploading, establish clear access rules, and start small by targeting a single repetitive administrative process.

zh.title: 用 Gemini Notebook 轻松搞定社内问答，告别繁琐翻规章
zh.summary: 只需上传现有的公司手册和文档，Gemini Notebook 就能快速打造专属的智能问答助手。它不仅能根据原文提供带依据的准确回答，还能自动生成常见问题解答和交接资料，**大大减轻**总务和人事部门的日常负担。
zh.full_summary:
处理关于报销、规章和系统操作的重复性内部咨询，常常让行政和人事部门苦不堪言。Gemini Notebook 通过读取现有的 PDF、文档和网页等资料，让企业无需重新编写内容就能快速搭建问答工具。当员工提问时，它不仅能给出准确回答，还会附带原始资料的出处，并在资料缺失时如实告知，避免 AI 瞎编。

除了日常答疑，它还能一键生成常见问题解答和工作交接资料，甚至能自动整理出演示幻灯片。为了确保数据安全，专家建议企业通过付费账号管理权限、严格核对上传资料的时效性，并采取从小范围单项业务开始试水的方式，逐步向全员推广。
